description:
Promotional rent: £1,560pcm for the first 12 months.
Standard rent: £1,850pcm thereafter.
To qualify, you must move in by 31 October 2026.
Utilities and other optional services are charged separately where applicable. Full promotional terms apply. 

Speak to our team to discuss the homes and offers currently available.

Here's a sneak peek of the quality and style you can expect in your apartment. Please note that the images are for illustrative purposes and exact design and layout may vary.

Brand new interior designed rental homes with state-of-the-art amenities included, 24hr gym, co-working space, private dining room, concierge and security, one-acre of landscaped gardens, secure parking and cycle storage. Exceptional service including free superfast Wi-Fi, pets welcome plus deposit alternatives, which makes it super accessible to start renting!

Moda, Loudon's Yard has everything on the doorstep. Transport links are within a 2-minute walk and Edgbaston Village filled with the best of what the area has to offer, local, independent, shops, bars and Michelin star restaurants. Feel like venturing out a little further for the day? Edgbaston Cricket Ground, home to the T20 team Birmingham Bears is just round the corner plus Birmingham Botanical Gardens a 10 minute walk.

YOUR APARTMENT
- Perfectly designed for families or couples
- Spacious primary bedroom with en-suite
- Second bedroom, also perfect for childs bedroom or an office
- House bathroom with bath and deluxe rainfall shower
- Open plan living with plush deep-seated sofa and lounge chair
- Fitted kitchen with dining space for four
- Floor to ceiling windows
- Dual facing aspect

YOUR KITCHEN
Open plan, sleek and modern with quartz worktops and integrated energy efficient appliances including touch control ceramic induction hob, dual fan oven, microwave, separate stacked fridge and freezer, dishwasher plus washer/dryer. Room to entertain with marble effect dining table and four chairs.

YOUR LIVING AREA
Light and spacious with floor to ceiling windows and. Plush stylish blackout blinds, deep-seated sofa and lounge chair, media storage unit and small coffee table in concrete effect.

YOUR BEDROOMS
Two spacious bedrooms including bespoke fitted wardrobes with full height mirror, hanging rail and storage. Ottoman bed with storage, feature luxurious velvet headboard and 1,000 individual pocket sprung mattress made from natural materials and dark wood bedside tables.

YOUR BATHROOMS
One en-suite bathroom with deluxe rainfall shower. One house bathroom with both a bath and rainfall shower with separate handheld shower. Both with WC and heated towel rail, plus under sink storge and feature lighting.

*Here's a sneak peek of the quality and style you can expect in your apartment. Please note that the images are for illustrative purposes and exact design and layout may vary.

Moda is the UK's number 1 rental brand, with rental neighbourhoods in 7 cities. Recently winning operator of the year and also achieving exceptional reviews on HomeViews, an independent platform that allows residents to give direct feedback and reviews on how we operate as your rental provider.

The rent shown is the amount you will pay each month, including the current promotional offer available on this specific home. The standard rent for this home, without the promotional concession is £1795.

Please note that utilities (including electricity, water, and heating, depending on your apartment), council tax, TV licence, parking (if required), and any optional extras or upgraded services are not included within your monthly rent.

*Council Tax Bands to be confirmed.
